name: Vyapar Books PRO
releaseNotes: Added a complete Delivery Challan workflow: create, edit, view, cancel, delete, search, date filters, and draft/dispatched/delivered/cancelled statuses
Capture Rule 55 purpose, consignee/ship-to address, vehicle, transporter, and 12-digit e-way bill details
Print/PDF and thermal receipts now use proper Delivery Challan labels and suppress payment, balance-due, and UPI blocks
One-tap conversion to a Tax Invoice with sequential numbering, stock decrement, and customer ledger posting only at conversion
Delivery Challans are available from the mobile drawer, tablet sidebar, and More menu with cashier/accountant access
Includes the v1.2.23 OTA update-check fix
